You don't need to code to work with AI.

Since 2022, College Copilot has been a community for students and early-career youth who want to understand AI and put it to work. AI is explained in plain language, then put to work on something real.

Competitions, training, and guides, built with companies and campus groups across Indonesia, turn what you learn into something you can build or ship.

Frequently asked questions

What is College Copilot?
College Copilot is the first and largest youth-led AI community in Indonesia. Since 2022, it has helped students and young people understand AI and use it to create real impact, even without coding skills.
Do I need to know how to code?
No. Most of what College Copilot shares is made for non-coders. AI is explained in plain language, then put to use on things like assignments, projects, and careers.
Who can join?
Any student or young person in Indonesia who wants to learn AI. The AI Bootcamp is also open to researchers and early-career professionals.
How do I join the community and stay updated?
Join the WhatsApp community group, and follow College Copilot on Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn for AI updates, programs, competitions, and opportunities.
Is the AI Handbook free?
The AI Handbook is a paid ebook. Open any Handbook above to see the details on its Lynk page.
How can my company or campus community partner with College Copilot?
Click Become a Partner and fill out the short form. Partners work with College Copilot on competitions, trainings, and programs that reach students across Indonesia.

Interested in partnering with us?

Tell us about your organization and what you'd like to build together with students and young people across Indonesia.
